N011: >How many scales do you really play?<
N012: >When the notes move, don’t you get lost?<
N013: >I did. On a Neotone, you change scale and the path is gone: your hand hunts around, your head spins. That’s cognitive overload. So you go back to the scales you know, and an instrument that could play anything ends up playing only a small part of what it can.<
N014: >The chord being played: the hands show the movement.<

N122: >Do I need Studio to connect my Neotone?<
N123: >No. Connecting it by USB or MIDI is free, with your playing shown in real time and the exercises for learning your scales. Studio opens up Neotone Connection, Logic mode and the duos.<
N125: >On a computer or tablet, in your browser. On a phone, the screen is too small to see your handpan and its chords properly.
